locally, the follower's 7.6e-4, diagnosed before this file (float64): central differences of the sweep converge to 1.7598042 at every step from 1e-4 to 3e-7 m (7 digits) against Study.gradient's 1.7584646; with the contact off and the body's moment zero (the loop cut) still 6.5e-4; after one tick (2 ms) 9.1e-5, reproduced on the law's own step and on the solve alone. The implicit derivative is -H^-1 g_s at the point returned (2.6e-9), but that point, a warm start two Newton steps in, is 3.7e-8 rad from the minimiser, where on this weakly regularised problem (effort 20 rad, the scaled Hessian's least eigenvalues 1e-8 of its largest) the derivative is 8e-5 off the minimiser's (-H^-1 g_s there = central differences of polished minimisers to 3e-9)

locally, after polishing (full steps within the tolerance while longer than the commands' rounding, at most 3): the law's step 1.2e-8 off central differences, the 10 ms follower Study.gradient 9.5e-9 (with the contact) and 2.0e-9 (loop cut); the warm-start draws' derivative within 1e-7 of central differences at 0.2 mm steps (at 2 um the reference solves' rounding reads 1e-5); without polishing (the plant) 7e-4 on the first draw
locally, the flag seam's changes: test_controller_flags.py 15 passed; its plant (unleveled) caught by all 8 loop-or-branch cases

locally, the polish blocked on the warm-start test's seed 198: a reference solve stopped 3.3e-9 rad from the minimiser because Armijo's test refused its full Newton step (scaled 1.6e-7): the measured decrease, -4e-20 (true 1.6e-21), is the rows' rounding, and the noise was judged on the rows' own scale (4 eps |r|^2, 1e-22), not on their terms' (link_6 at 640 in rows of 4e-4). Fixed: each row's rounding taken as eps of the problem's size, which bounds its terms

locally, then seed 740: a reference solve met the tolerance (5.3e-11) 2.3e-3 rad from the minimiser, its objective 37 % above the minimum; its full Newton step raised the objective by 4.7e-9 (far above the noise) and converged: steps 0.24, 7e-4, 1e-3, 4e-8, 2e-12 (scaled), the Maratos effect in the curved valley of the redundant joints. Fixed: the polish became Newton's local phase (from the first point within the tolerance, full steps with no line search, at most POLISHING_STEPS, now 8; the point within the tolerance whose step was shortest returned)

locally, then seed 1195: a warm start 0.1 mrad from the minimiser took the cap of 50 iterations, Armijo halving the full step at every other iteration, and returned a point within the tolerance its local phase never reached (7e-7 of the derivative off). Fixed: the cap read at a weighed point, and Armijo's test nonmonotone (the largest objective of the last MEMORY, 4, points) for Newton's step on a positive definite Hessian that no bound cuts. Unrestricted, the allowance cut the follower's most iterations to 13 but cycled a float32 OctoMag draw between two corners of the box for the whole cap (the exact-path agreement test failed) and sent the inverse kinematics' solve to a limit on 6 of 200 draws (2 before); restricted, over 2220 of the warm-start test's solves (60 draws, each with its 36 differenced solves) every one converged and ended within the commands' rounding, iterations at most 35 (47 monotone), mean 4.77, and the inverse kinematics reached a limit on 3 of 200 draws, each one the library's solve misses as well

the tests' reference solves: the TOLERANCE 1e-15 patch around them never reached the compiled program in a clean run (the solve is jitted once, by the found solve, before the patch); removed, the references are the library's own solves, polished to rounding, each asserted converged

the inverse-kinematics test's other branch assumed the library fails only by leaving the limits; on seed 729201 its damped steps stopped 1.2e-7 m short of its 1e-9 tolerance in 200 iterations inside the limits, the solve here on the pose to 1e-16 m. Restated: a solve held at no limit reaches the reachable pose to 1e-9 m; the joints are compared where the library reaches the pose inside the limits

the loose plant redefined as the tolerance one AND no local phase: with the local phase a loose tolerance only starts Newton's full steps earlier, which end at the minimiser on an affine model, so there was no wrong claim to catch (the plants test caught nothing until then)

the solve walk saw no solve in the controller's step: JAX 0.12 writes lax.custom_root as call_hi_primitive, its solve in the primitive object (pp_params), not in the equation's parameters; the walk's reading was wrong, the dense site's registration right. The host-callback probe (a debug print inside the root find's solve went unseen) and the switch scan (the solve's 37 raw sites unseen) shared the blind spot; all three now read held_programs

the inverse-kinematics test's joint comparison assumed one joint solution per pose; the AR4's wrist has two (joints 4 and 6 turned by pi, joint 5 negated), and the solve from near the wrist's singular pose reaches the other on about 1.5 % of draws, before this round's changes too (seed 149). Restated: on the pose, and the joints within 1e-6 of the library's or on the other branch (more than 0.5 rad apart). The test's solve is now compiled once per plant, and its early plant is applied (it never was: its control arm would have read 0 caught)
arm_draw wrote into a read-only array (np.asarray of a JAX value) on every unreachable draw, so the unreachable derivative test could not have passed before; fixed with a copy

locally, then seed 1210936 (the warm-start test): a reference solve crawled by halvings in the indefinite region of the curved valley (Gauss-Newton steps of 1.5 to 3.5, scaled, cut each time) and met the cap 0.027 rad from the minimiser, unconverged. Fixed: Levenberg's damping after a cut step (DAMPING 1e-3, times 10 at each further cut, over 10 at each whole step, none in the local phase). With it and the restricted allowance, 2220 of 2220 follower solves converged within the commands' rounding, at most 15 iterations, mean 4.75 (without the allowance 3 met the cap); the inverse kinematics reached a limit on 3 of 200 draws, each one the library misses too; the float32 OctoMag draw converged in 5. The test files were not re-run after this change before the commit that records it

operating_point.platform: CPU; GitHub runners, 4 vCPU; the cost arm and the bits on one CPU with one BLAS and XLA thread
operating_point.sizes_and_parameters: the agreement draws: allocation_draws.problems on Navion_2, CardioMag and OctoMag (field, gradient, both, force; limits 5 to 50 A; wanted 0.1 to 4 of the reach), an effort of 1 to 100 A on half of them and 30 A where the rows do not fix the coils; nine to sixteen synthetic commands, tall by 0 to 6 rows, singular values 0.3 to 3, regularised on half. The arm: A0's AR4, link_6's position over 1 mm and orientation over 10 mrad, a box of 0.05 rad around the last joints, unreachable targets moved 1.5 m and regularised at 20 rad. The controller rigs: A0's rig with the follower (graph and callback, dt and rates of chain_cases.tracked_rpm), the R2 coil sphere (dt 1 ms, the controller every 5 ms, one step late, 25 A ports) on the iterative path by EXACT_COMMANDS patched to 2
operating_point.seeds_and_draws: Hypothesis: 100 examples a dtype for the agreement with the exact path, 60 for BVLS, 40 for the arm's derivative (each kind of target), its inverse kinematics and float32; detection rates at 20 runs a control (10 for the flag's), each with its Hypothesis seed

gate_1_agreement_exact.claim: on the arrays MIME ships, the iterative path's commands are the exact path's within the line its claim derives, it converges, and its stationarity is under the declared tolerance, in both dtypes

prediction.basis: measured-before (the pilot, 600 draws of six coils; the local run)
prediction.why: on a convex quadratic projected Newton's step is the exact path's least squares once the active set is found

control.plant: early (two iterations), loose (tolerance one, no local phase): each must leave a draw unconverged, past the declared line, or past the derived distance

gate_1_agreement_exact.if_wrong: a clean failure is a defect of the active set's identification or of the claim's line; a missed plant means the draws do not need more than two iterations, and the draws are widened

gate_2_agreement_bvls.claim: on nine to sixteen commands SciPy's BVLS is the oracle, at camera spike R2's line plus the derived distance, in both dtypes

prediction.why: as gate 1, with BVLS's own line

gate_3_derivative.claim: the arm's implicit derivative in its target, its turn and its last joints (a slew box's bounds active) is central differences of reference solves on its branch within 1e-6 of its largest entry, and reverse mode is forward mode within 1e-12, on reachable and unreachable targets

prediction.basis: measured-before (the pilot: medians 1e-9 to 3e-6 at steps of 1e-3; the probe takes 0.2 and 0.1, which keep the reference solves' noise at about 1e-7 of the move)
prediction.why: Richardson's truncation at a 0.2 mm move is about 1e-10; the reference solves are the library's own, polished to the commands' rounding by the local phase

control.plant: gauss_newton (the root's Hessian Gauss-Newton's: 0.5 to 13 off on every unreachable draw in the pilot); bounds (a held command's derivative zero, where the box holds a joint on every draw, asserted)

gate_3_derivative.if_wrong: a clean draw past 1e-6 on the solution's branch is a defect of the tangent system; one whose reference solves leave the branch at every step is a kink on both sides, reported by its seed
gate_3_derivative.cannot_discriminate_if: the box held no joint (asserted on every draw), or the residual were zero (the unreachable draws keep it far from zero)

gate_3b_warm_start.claim: at the follower's operating point (the joints read are the start and the effort's reference, the target 0.2 to 2 mm from where they put the flange, effort 20 rad), the derivative in the target and the joints read is central differences of the library's own reference solves, each converged within 1e-6 of its largest entry

prediction.basis: measured-before (local, after the three fixes: the 40-example run; the 2220-solve survey's solves all within rounding)
prediction.why: the local phase takes the commands to the minimiser to rounding; the reference solves' rounding over a 0.2 mm step is about 1e-7

control.plant: unpolished (POLISHING_STEPS zero: no local phase): the derivative at the first point the tolerance admits, 7e-4 off on the first local draw

gate_3b_warm_start.if_wrong: a clean draw past 1e-6 whose commands are the reference's is the differences' noise (the step is widened, never the line); one whose commands are not is polishing's defect
gate_3b_warm_start.cannot_discriminate_if: a draw's solve reaches rounding before the tolerance stops it (the plant then changes nothing): the rate says how often the draws reach the sensitive case

gate_4_inverse_kinematics.claim: on reachable poses the iterative solve converges; where it holds no joint at a limit it reaches the pose within 1e-9 m; and where the library's inverse kinematics reaches the pose within the limits from the same start, the solve is on the pose and its joints are the library's within 1e-6 rad or the wrist's other solution (more than 0.5 rad apart)

prediction.basis: measured-before (the pilot: 119 of 120 reachable draws on the target to 3e-10 m; the other a local minimiser at a limit, where the library's step ignores the limits)
prediction.why: both are Newton-like from 0.15 rad away on the same model

control.plant: early (two iterations: the reachable solves take 3 to 21)

gate_4_inverse_kinematics.if_wrong: a draw between 1e-6 and 0.5 rad of the library's joints on the pose is a defect of the solve's precision; one off the pose held at no limit is a local minimiser the claim does not admit

gate_5_float32.claim: the arm's solve in float32 converges where float64's does, its joints within 1e-3 rad and its derivative within 1e-2 of float64's largest entry

prediction.why: the stationarity's floor in float32 is about 1e-7 of the size

control.plant: none: a judgement of float32 against float64

gate_5_float32.if_wrong: an unconverged float32 draw means the floor still exceeds 1e-5 there: the tolerance is raised above the measured floor and the change recorded

gate_6_real_path.claim: through a built controller: the follower writes the same joints in both modes to the dtype's rounding and puts its flange above the body; an exact-path controller declares no flag and builds no holder; an unregularised follower is refused (allocation.objective); a capped solve raises allocation_unconverged at every step in both modes, counted and warned, its value past the tolerance, and a converged one none; the coil sphere on the iterative path writes the exact path's currents within 1e4 eps of 25 A in both dtypes and modes; a study sweeps the follower's standoff; Study.gradient in the coil sphere's kp through the iterative path is central differences within 1e-3; and the flag seam: a declared flag reads controller.far_from_goal in the layout, the report and the run, raised at the same ticks in graph, callback and jitted-callback modes; a study's members and Study.gradient's carry it at that path; a raise inside cond, while_loop, scan or fori_loop is refused naming the rule in both modes; an undeclared name names its declaration; an ahead-of-time compiled step is refused

gate_6_real_path.if_wrong: a mode disagreement is the flag carrier's or the holder's defect
